verdict.rationale: Navan offers rule-based policy and approval workflows that run without user involvement, and webhooks that let users build their own event-driven automations. Ava is also described as proactively finding savings. However, the MCP and Ava surfaces are on-demand natural-language querying, and Navan Edge explicitly requires confirmation before any booking action, so there is no evidence of user-configurable autonomous background agents or scheduled automations. Missing for 10: user-defined scheduled/background automation or agent jobs, autonomous AI actions without per-step confirmation, documentation of how automations are configured and run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
